summary: Iter 216h147 - Engineer self-claim queue feature testing completed. Backend 7/7 tests pass. Frontend queue page, claim modal, EngineerHomeV2 qa-queue button, EngineerWorkspace ws-nav-queue button, and 'q' keyboard shortcut all working correctly.

routing_issue.issue: Direct URL navigation to /svc/engineer/queue redirects to /dashboard on full page reload. The protectedRoutes array in App.js (line 539) doesn't include /svc/engineer/* routes, causing the loading state to not show while auth is being verified, which results in AppRoutes rendering with user=null and redirecting to /login. SPA navigation works correctly.
routing_issue.workaround: Use SPA navigation (React Router links) instead of direct URL access. The qa-queue button and 'q' shortcut work correctly.
